from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A single financial line item extracted from a document's statements."""
    label: str = Field(description="The exact label of the line item as written in the document (e.g., 'Distributable Income')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    statement_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial statement section this item belongs to")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document containing the item")

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single document/filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The legal name of the company or trust in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered (e.g., 'Quarter ended March 31, 2024')")
    basis_of_accounting: str | None = Field(description="The accounting basis, e.g., 'GAAP', 'Modified Cash Basis', 'Tax Basis'")
    financial_items: list[FinancialItem] = Field(description="List of all financial line items relevant to cash, income, and assets found in the statements")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
